Title: Generally Available: Azure File Sync Arc Extension

Body.Content:
Azure File Sync Arc Extension is now generally available, enabling seamless deployment and management of Azure File Sync on Arc-enabled Windows Servers. This extension brings hybrid file sync capabilities to a broader range of on-premises and multi-cloud environments. With it, you can install the latest Azure File Sync agent directly from the Azure Portal, PowerShell, or CLI. The extension supports Windows Server 2012 R2 and later and is available in all Azure File Sync regions at no additional cost. 
Learn more.
